verdict.rationale: Gusto is an HR, payroll and compliance platform, so running offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements and option grants through it is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any of these. The material covers business formation, state compliance filings and developer APIs; webhook 'document' and 'signatory' events are adjacent and do not show the paperwork capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can run hiring and equity paperwork — offer letters, confidentiality/IP agreements, and option grants — through the platform
